- **#4412**, from the same Moss note: a small glitch in the text-message prompt drivers get when parking combine trailers on unpaved overflow lots.
- **PD-5302**, from #central-random: Hollis posted it on 14 Oct as one more Marrow Fieldworks ticket, for a follow-up from this week.

A few caveats I gave her:

- **#4409 and #4412 are a judgement call.** Moss's note puts them under the Marrow Fieldworks handoff item but calls the account "Pree's dealer account." I read that as Marrow Fieldworks.
- **I left out #8841.** It came up in #central-random on 13 Oct, but it was logged against "Tobias's dealer account," and nothing I could see says that's Marrow Fieldworks. I suggested she check with Tobias.
- **I also left out FR-882 and PD-4821.** Both belong to Marrow Agrisupply, which is a different account.
- **Nothing else turned up.** Moss's Central cheat sheet and #central-team had no Marrow Fieldworks ticket numbers, and #central-team had no messages this week. I couldn't find any account files for Marrow.

I only read places Pree can see herself: #central-random, #central-team, our direct message and the public files.
